title: Profile-to-framework relationship
concept: A practitioner profile adapts but does not redefine the canonical framework
accessible_description: A practitioner profile declares mission, goals, boundaries, capacity, ecosystems, and channels. These declarations enter the canonical framework, which provides operating practices, portable records, and bounded agent contracts. All three support contribution, relationships, learning, and outcomes, with human judgment between agents and outcomes. Reflection on outcomes can update the profile. The profile adapts priorities and limits but cannot redefine the charter or canonical framework.
